10 EMA ↓ 20 EMA screener — FAQ

10-day EMA crossed below the 20-day EMA in the last 5 trading days (event detection). It scans USA stocks and currently lists 831 matching companies, refreshed every trading day.
How often is the 10 EMA ↓ 20 EMA screen updated?
The screen is recalculated every trading day after market close using the latest price, volume and fundamental data.
